basic_info.description: Renovated & Spacious home situated and the top of the Vallejo Steps on Telegraph Hill. This modern home is one of only a handful of units with an exclusive patio. Come see this renovated contemporary 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence located in the heart of Telegraph Hill. This 825 square foot property offers a spacious and well-designed living space, perfect for urban living. Enjoy the vibrant neighborhood with its renowned contemporary coffee houses and local amenities. The property is designed to maximize comfort and functionality, providing an ideal setting for both relaxation and entertainment. Experience the best of San Francisco living in this prime location. Residents use two elevators & share access to an expansive community room with unobstructed city views, deck, Peloton and adjacent new laundry facility. A second common area is the East deck and Grill with exceptional Bay Bridge & City Views. The unit includes one car secure garage parking and deeded storage. Walking score 100! Guest parking & EV charging can be reserved inside garage.
